limitations: Default legacy BLOCK_RECORD raw/model capture already existed; the additional structural/replay budget is opt-in through existing BLOCK-source selection. Selection exceptions and exhausted opt-in structural budgets leave replay unqualified.

Strict complete physical field grammar, XDATA and APPID/LAYER role/target validation, original identity census, BLOCK/compound membership and graph/output qualification remain separate. A tolerated unknown field can replay successfully but cannot gain authority.
